07597 Sh@'altiy'el {sheh-al-tee-ale'} 或 Shaltiy'el {shal-tee-ale'}

源自 07592 與 0410; 陽性專有名詞 人名

欽定本 - Shealtiel 8, Salathiel 1; 9

撒拉鐵 = "我問過神"
1) 所羅巴伯之父 (#拉 3:2|, 參見 [6305])
2) 猶大王 約雅斤(或耶歌尼雅, 歌尼雅) 的兒子, 所羅巴伯的叔叔 (#代上 3:17-19|)

07597 Sh@'altiy'el {sheh-al-tee-ale'} or Shaltiy'el {shal-tee-ale'}

from 07592 and 0410;; n pr m

AV - Shealtiel 8, Salathiel 1; 9

Shealtiel or Salathiel = "I have asked of God"
1) father of Zerubbabel
2) son of king Jehoiachin or Jeconiah or Coniah of Judah and uncle of
   Zerubbabel
